{{Top|leg}}
The '''TravRat Gap''' was a route out of [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] between the [[Traveler's Palace]] and the [[Curat Commercial Center]], about an eighth of the way around the plaza from the [[Arakyd Towers ThroughPass]]. It was ten meters wide, with a multi-kilometer drop below once past the edge of the plaza, and came out into the [[Four-Thousand Skylane]].
